text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both posting modest gains today, with Ethereum slightly outpacing Bitcoin, suggesting some rotation into altcoin strength despite dominant macro uncertainty. The Fear & Greed Index at 34 and declining over the past week indicates persistent investor caution, even as prices edge higher. Bitcoin's dominance holding firm at 59.3% against $74B in daily volume shows the market remains risk-averse and concentrated in the largest assets rather than chasing smaller positions.
